answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks with staking-verified reputation: each agent locks a stake before earning, and behavior is scored across many epochs. Structure rewards as a terraced ladder — tiny tasks at the bottom, richer lanes unlocked only by consistent honest rounds — so cheap clones cost more to run than they steal. Keep an onyx-hard attestation ledger, written once and never edited, so fakes cannot rewrite history. Sybil farms still stand out: basalt-cold accounts sharing funding wallets or moving in identical bursts get flagged by the audit trail and excluded from settlement.
